sections.title: Introduction
body: Alpha Digital Solutions ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you visit our website or engage our marketplace store creation and management services, how we use it, and the choices you have.
By using our website or services you agree to the practices described in this policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or submit your information to us.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: We collect information you give us directly and information collected automatically when you use the website.
- Contact details — your name, email address, phone number, company name and website when you complete our contact form, request a quote or book a consultation.
- Project information — details about your products, marketplaces, goals, budget and any files you attach to an enquiry.
- Newsletter data — your email address when you subscribe to our newsletter.

- Account and store data — where you engage us to create or manage a store, information needed to perform the work, such as marketplace account access you grant us, product catalogues, pricing, order and advertising data.
- Technical data — IP address, browser type, device, pages visited and referring URLs, collected through server logs and analytics cookies.

sections.title: How we use your information
body: We use your information to:
- Respond to your enquiries and provide quotes, proposals and consultations.
- Deliver, manage and improve the services you engage us for.
- Send our newsletter and marketing communications where you have opted in. You can unsubscribe at any time.
- Operate, secure and improve our website and understand how it is used.
- Comply with legal obligations and enforce our agreements.
We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
body: Where data-protection laws such as the UK GDPR or EU GDPR apply, we process your information on the basis of your consent (for example, newsletter subscriptions), the performance of a contract with you (delivering our services), our legitimate interests (responding to enquiries, securing and improving the website) and compliance with legal obligations.

sections.title: How we share information
body: We share personal information only with trusted service providers who help us run our business, and only to the extent necessary:
- Email delivery providers that send our transactional emails, enquiry notifications and newsletters.
- Hosting and infrastructure providers that serve this website.
- Marketplace platforms (such as Amazon, eBay, Etsy, OnBuy, TikTok Shop and Shopify) when we act on your behalf within accounts you have authorised us to manage.
- Professional advisers, regulators or law enforcement where required by law.
Our providers are contractually required to protect your information and use it only for the services they provide to us.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
body: Our website uses strictly necessary cookies to function, and may use analytics cookies to understand how visitors use the site so we can improve it. You can control cookies through your browser settings; disabling some cookies may affect how the site works.

sections.title: Data retention
body: We keep personal information only for as long as needed for the purposes described above. Enquiry data is generally retained for up to 24 months after our last contact with you; client data is retained for the duration of our engagement and for any period required by law or to resolve disputes. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

sections.title: Security
body: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls and reputable third-party providers. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: International transfers
body: We serve clients in the USA, UK and UAE and may process information in countries other than your own. Where we transfer information internationally we take steps to ensure it receives an adequate level of protection, such as using providers that offer appropriate contractual safeguards.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:
- Access the personal information we hold about you.
- Ask us to correct inaccurate or incomplete information.
- Ask us to delete your information, subject to legal exceptions.
- Object to or restrict certain processing, including direct marketing.
- Withdraw consent at any time where processing is based on consent.
- Lodge a complaint with your local data-protection authority.
To exercise any of these rights, email alphaecommerce99@gmail.com. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law.

sections.title: Children
body: Our website and services are intended for businesses and individuals aged 18 or over. We do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: Third-party links
body: Our website may link to third-party websites, including marketplace platforms and social networks. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to read their policies.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised. Significant changes will be highlighted on this page.

sections.title: Contact us
body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, contact Alpha Digital Solutions at alphaecommerce99@gmail.com or +92 320-8147272, or write to our head office at 1st Floor, Shop# 1, Eden Orchard, Sargodha Road, Faisalabad, Pakistan.

sections.title: Agreement to these terms
body: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the Alpha Digital Solutions website and the services provided by Alpha Digital Solutions ("we", "us", "our"). By accessing the website or engaging our services you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy.
Where you sign a separate proposal, statement of work or service agreement with us, that document takes precedence over these Terms to the extent of any conflict.

sections.title: Our services
body: We provide marketplace store creation and management services across Amazon, eBay, Etsy, OnBuy, TikTok Shop and Shopify, including store setup, listing optimisation, advertising management, order and inventory support and account health management.
The scope, deliverables, timelines and fees for any engagement are set out in the proposal or agreement we issue to you. Work outside the agreed scope will be quoted separately.

sections.title: Your responsibilities
body: To allow us to deliver the services you agree to:
- Provide accurate, complete and timely information, content, product data and approvals.
- Grant and maintain the marketplace account access we reasonably need, and keep that access secure.
- Hold all rights, licences and permissions for the products, brands, images and content you ask us to use.
- Comply with the policies of each marketplace and with all applicable laws, including consumer, tax and product-safety requirements.
- Pay our fees on time in accordance with the agreed payment terms.

sections.title: Marketplace accounts and third-party platforms
body: Marketplace accounts remain yours at all times. We act on your behalf within the permissions you grant us. Marketplaces are operated by independent third parties whose policies, fees, algorithms and decisions (including listing removals, account suspensions and Buy Box eligibility) are outside our control.
We will use reasonable skill and care to keep your account compliant, but we do not guarantee any particular ranking, sales volume, approval, reinstatement or outcome on any platform.

sections.title: Fees and payment
body: Fees are stated in your proposal or agreement and are exclusive of taxes unless stated otherwise. Advertising spend, marketplace fees, subscription fees and other third-party costs are payable by you in addition to our fees unless we agree otherwise in writing.

Invoices are due by the date shown on the invoice. We may suspend work on overdue accounts and charge reasonable interest and recovery costs on late payments. Fees paid for work already performed are non-refundable.

sections.title: Term and termination
body: Ongoing management services continue for the period stated in your agreement and renew automatically unless either party gives the notice set out there (30 days by default). Either party may terminate immediately if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within 14 days of written notice.
On termination you remain liable for fees for work performed up to the termination date, and we will hand back any account access, credentials and materials belonging to you.

sections.title: Intellectual property
body: You retain ownership of your brand, products, content and data. Upon full payment, you own the deliverables we create specifically for you (such as listing copy, images and store designs).

We retain ownership of our methods, templates, tools, know-how and any pre-existing materials, and grant you a licence to use them as part of the deliverables. The website, its design and its content are owned by us and may not be copied or reused without permission.
You grant us permission to reference you as a client and to showcase non-confidential results in our portfolio unless you tell us otherwise in writing.

sections.title: Confidentiality
body: Each party will keep the other's confidential information (including pricing, sales data, credentials and business plans) secure and use it only to perform or receive the services. This obligation survives termination of our engagement.

sections.title: Use of the website
body: You may use our website for lawful purposes only. You must not attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of the site, interfere with its operation, scrape its content or submit false or misleading information through our forms.
The website is provided on an "as is" basis. We aim to keep it available and accurate but do not guarantee uninterrupted access or that all content is error-free.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, consequential or special loss, loss of profit, revenue, sales or goodwill, or for losses caused by marketplace decisions, platform outages, changes to third-party policies or your failure to meet your responsibilities.

Our total liability to you arising from any engagement is limited to the fees you paid us for that engagement in the 12 months before the event giving rise to the claim. Nothing in these Terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including for fraud or death or personal injury caused by negligence.

sections.title: Indemnity
body: You agree to indemnify us against claims, losses and costs arising from the products you sell, the content and materials you supply, your breach of marketplace policies or applicable law, or your breach of these Terms.

sections.title: General
body: These Terms, together with your proposal or agreement and our Privacy Policy, form the entire agreement between us. If any provision is found unenforceable the remainder continues in effect. Neither party is liable for delays caused by events beyond its reasonable control. We may update these Terms from time to time; the version published on this page at the time of your engagement applies.

These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction in which Alpha Digital Solutions is registered, and the courts of that jurisdiction have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute, unless your service agreement states otherwise.
